source: 第1行（所选荧光/标记策略 + 透明方法）：**[NeuN + Alexa Fluor 647（胞体）, β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647（轴突/树突）, TO-PRO-3（全脑核染）] + iDISCO+（DBE RI匹配）**
english: Line 1 (selected fluorescence/labeling strategy + clearing method): **[NeuN + Alexa Fluor 647 (somata), β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647 (axons/dendrites), TO-PRO-3 (whole-brain nuclear staining)] + iDISCO+ (DBE RI matching)**

source: 选择理由：iDISCO+ 适用于完整成年小鼠全脑（~10×8×6 mm）快速高透明化与光片成像；有机溶剂脱水/脱脂后透明度高、纤维束走行对比好；TO-PRO-3 与 Alexa Fluor 647 在iDISCO+流程中信号相对稳健，适合全脑三维神经元胞体与神经突起形态图谱构建。
english: Rationale for selection: iDISCO+ is suitable for rapid, highly transparent clearing and light-sheet imaging of an intact adult mouse whole brain (~10×8×6 mm); organic-solvent dehydration/delipidation produces high transparency and good contrast of fiber-tract trajectories. TO-PRO-3 and Alexa Fluor 647 signals are relatively robust in the iDISCO+ workflow, making them suitable for constructing whole-brain three-dimensional morphological maps of neuronal somata and neurites.

source: **Protocol Steps：**
english: **Protocol Steps:**

source: 1 预处理与脱水（Dehydration）
english: 1 Pretreatment and dehydration (Dehydration)

source: 1.1 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液浸泡，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
english: 1.1 Soak in 20% (vol/vol) methanol/water solution with gentle shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

source: 1.2 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液浸泡，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
english: 1.2 Soak in 40% (vol/vol) methanol/water solution with gentle shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

source: 1.3 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液浸泡，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
english: 1.3 Soak in 60% (vol/vol) methanol/water solution with gentle shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

source: 1.4 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液浸泡，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
english: 1.4 Soak in 80% (vol/vol) methanol/water solution with gentle shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

source: 1.5 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇浸泡，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
english: 1.5 Soak in 100% (vol/vol) methanol with gentle shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

source: 1.6 新鲜 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇再次浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
english: 1.6 Soak again in fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

source: 2 脱色/去血红素（Bleaching，可显著降低全脑背景）
english: 2 Bleaching / heme removal (Bleaching, which can substantially reduce whole-brain background)

source: 2.1 5% H2O2 in 甲醇（体积比：30% H2O2 : 甲醇 = 1 : 5）避光浸泡。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–16 hours)
english: 2.1 Soak in 5% H2O2 in methanol (volume ratio: 30% H2O2 : methanol = 1 : 5), protected from light.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–16 hours)

source: 3 复水（Rehydration）
english: 3 Rehydration (Rehydration)

source: 3.1 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
english: 3.1 Soak in 80% (vol/vol) methanol/water solution.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

source: 3.2 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
english: 3.2 Soak in 60% (vol/vol) methanol/water solution.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

source: 3.3 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
english: 3.3 Soak in 40% (vol/vol) methanol/water solution.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

source: 3.4 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
english: 3.4 Soak in 20% (vol/vol) methanol/water solution.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

source: 3.5 1×PBS 浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
english: 3.5 Soak in 1×PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

source: 4 渗透/封闭（Permeabilization & Blocking）
english: 4 Permeabilization / blocking (Permeabilization & Blocking)

source: 4.1 渗透液：PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M Glycine，轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
english: 4.1 Permeabilization solution: PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M Glycine, with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

source: 4.2 封闭液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清（NDS），轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
english: 4.2 Blocking solution: PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS), with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

source: 5 一抗全脑免疫标记（Whole-brain immunolabeling, primary）
english: 5 Whole-brain immunolabeling with primary antibodies (Whole-brain immunolabeling, primary)

source: 5.1 一抗孵育液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% DMSO + 3% NDS + 0.01% (w/v) NaN3；加入 NeuN (RBFOX3) 一抗 1:200。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days)
english: 5.1 Primary antibody incubation solution: PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% DMSO + 3% NDS + 0.01% (w/v) NaN3; add NeuN (RBFOX3) primary antibody at 1:200.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days)

source: 5.2 同一孵育液中加入 β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) 一抗 1:300（与5.1可同管共孵育）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days)
english: 5.2 Add β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) primary antibody at 1:300 to the same incubation solution (may be co-incubated in the same tube with 5.1).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days)

source: 6 洗涤（Wash after primary）
english: 6 Washing (Wash after primary)

source: 6.1 洗涤液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 0.01% NaN3，轻摇换液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
english: 6.1 Wash solution: PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 0.01% NaN3; change the solution with gentle shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

source: 6.2 重复 6.1 共 6 次（总洗涤约 36 hours）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 36 hours)
english: 6.2 Repeat 6.1 for a total of 6 times (approximately 36 hours of washing in total).(Temperature: RT, Time: 36 hours)

source: 7 二抗全脑免疫标记（Secondary, far-red）
english: 7 Whole-brain immunolabeling with secondary antibodies (Secondary, far-red)

source: 7.1 二抗孵育液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 3% NDS + 0.01% NaN3；加入驴抗鼠/兔（按一抗宿主匹配）Alexa Fluor 647 二抗 1:400（分别对应NeuN与TUJ1；若两一抗宿主不同可同管共孵育）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days, Light: protected)
english: 7.1 Secondary antibody incubation solution: PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 3% NDS + 0.01% NaN3; add donkey anti-mouse/rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 secondary antibodies at 1:400, matched to the primary antibody hosts (corresponding to NeuN and TUJ1 respectively; if the two primary antibodies have different hosts, they may be co-incubated in the same tube).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days, Light: protected)

source: 8 洗涤（Wash after secondary）
english: 8 Washing (Wash after secondary)

source: 8.1 PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 0.01% NaN3 洗涤，轻摇换液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
english: 8.1 Wash in PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 0.01% NaN3, changing the solution with gentle shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

source: 8.2 重复 8.1 共 6 次（总洗涤约 36 hours）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 36 hours)
english: 8.2 Repeat 8.1 for a total of 6 times (approximately 36 hours of washing in total).(Temperature: RT, Time: 36 hours)

source: 9 核染（TO-PRO-3，全脑核定位辅助配准/分区）
english: 9 Nuclear staining (TO-PRO-3, whole-brain nuclear localization to assist registration / regional delineation)

source: 9.1 TO-PRO-3 1–2 µM（在PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100中），避光轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours)
english: 9.1 TO-PRO-3 at 1–2 µM (in PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100), with gentle shaking protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours)

source: 9.2 PBS 洗涤 3 次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours each)
english: 9.2 Wash 3 times in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours each)

source: 10 再次脱水（Dehydration before clearing）
english: 10 Dehydration again (Dehydration before clearing)

source: 10.1 20% 甲醇/水。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
english: 10.1 20% methanol/water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

source: 10.2 40% 甲醇/水。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
english: 10.2 40% methanol/water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

source: 10.3 60% 甲醇/水。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
english: 10.3 60% methanol/water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

source: 10.4 80% 甲醇/水。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
english: 10.4 80% methanol/water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

source: 10.5 100% 甲醇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
english: 10.5 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

source: 10.6 新鲜 100% 甲醇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
english: 10.6 Fresh 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

source: 11 脱脂/透明化前处理（Delipidation with DCM）
english: 11 Delipidation / pre-clearing treatment (Delipidation with DCM)

source: 11.1 66% (vol/vol) 二氯甲烷(DCM)/33% 甲醇混合液浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
english: 11.1 Soak in a mixture of 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM)/33% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

source: 11.2 100% DCM 浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1.5 hours)
english: 11.2 Soak in 100% DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1.5 hours)

source: 12 RI 匹配（Refractive index matching, DBE）
english: 12 RI matching (Refractive index matching, DBE)

source: 12.1 100% 二苄醚（DBE, RI≈1.56）预浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, Light: protected)
english: 12.1 Pre-soak in 100% dibenzyl ether (DBE, RI≈1.56).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, Light: protected)

source: 12.2 新鲜 100% DBE 继续浸泡至完全透明（全脑通常需要）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours, Light: protected)
english: 12.2 Continue soaking in fresh 100% DBE until completely transparent (usually needed for a whole brain).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours, Light: protected)

source: 13 保存与成像前处理（Storage & pre-imaging）
english: 13 Storage and pre-imaging treatment (Storage & pre-imaging)

source: 13.1 样本全程浸没于新鲜 100% DBE，避光密封保存（尽量充满容器减少氧化）。(Temperature: RT or 4 ℃, Time: up to 1–2 weeks)
english: 13.1 Keep the sample fully immersed in fresh 100% DBE, sealed and protected from light for storage (fill the container as much as possible to reduce oxidation).(Temperature: RT or 4 ℃, Time: up to 1–2 weeks)

source: 13.2 光片成像前更换一次新鲜 DBE 并静置脱气泡/沉降。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1–2 hours)
english: 13.2 Before light-sheet imaging, replace with fresh DBE once and let stand for bubble removal/settling.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1–2 hours)

source: 13.3 成像介质与物镜匹配：使用 RI≈1.56 的DBE兼容成像腔与密封材料；样本固定于支架后直接进行全脑光片扫描。(Temperature: RT, Time: per imaging session)
english: 13.3 Match the imaging medium to the objective: use a DBE-compatible imaging chamber and sealing materials for RI≈1.56; after fixing the sample to the holder, proceed directly to whole-brain light-sheet scanning.(Temperature: RT, Time: per imaging session)
